question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget be accepted as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should this wait for a richer session activity contract before the issue closes?
rationale: The requested UI is coherent, but the durable source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing choice that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Review the linked widget PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the active candidate and close this issue only if that PR lands or is replaced by an equivalent implementation.

options.title: Wait for activity API
options.body: Keep this issue open until a richer `sessions.activity.*` or equivalent activity contract is accepted, then build the widget against that source.

recommendation.title: Review the linked widget PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the active candidate and close this issue only if that PR lands or is replaced by an equivalent implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses Control UI product direction, widget security/review boundaries, and session-status presentation, where steipete has the strongest available product-review signal.
